signIn.title: Sign in to ZAWED
signIn.subtitle: Use the email and password ZAWED Operations gave you.
signIn.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask ZAWED Operations to reset it.

mfa.title: Enter your verification code
mfa.description: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for ZAWED.

enroll.title: Set up two-step verification
enroll.description: Your role requires a code from an authenticator app at every sign-in.
enroll.step1: Install an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
enroll.step2: Scan this code with the app.
enroll.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app
enroll.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
enroll.qrLabel: QR code for setting up two-step verification

password.title: Choose a new password
password.forcedDescription: Your password was set by ZAWED. Choose your own before you continue.
password.description: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
password.rule: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.wrongCurrent: Your current password is not correct.

noAccess.title: This area is not for your account
noAccess.description: You are signed in as {{name}} ({{role}}). Your account opens a different area of ZAWED.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is not correct.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min, or ask ZAWED Operations to unlock your account.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is not active. Contact ZAWED Operations.
errors.MFA_INVALID_CODE: That code is not correct. Wait for a new code and try again.
errors.MFA_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: This sign-in took too long. Please sign in again.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK: Use at least {{min}} characters, and do not include your email.
errors.PASSWORD_REUSED: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: ZAWED can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
